title: Deep Learning Unravels Differences Between Kinematic and Kinetic Gait Cycle Time Series from Two Control Samples of Healthy Children Assessed in Two Different Gait Laboratories
summary: Deep learning analyzed gait-cycle signals from healthy children assessed at two laboratories and quantified laboratory-related differences between kinematic and kinetic series.
ai_technology: gait laboratory measurements; Results report classifier performance and signal differences by laboratory

evidence.unknown: The findings are limited to the reported dataset, experimental setup and validation described in the source; broader generalization and real-world benefit were not established.
